text: Hannah - her dad passed Sun. funeral prob end of the month, St Mary's. send card + ask if she needs anything
Sam & Gemma split up :( she's kept the flat in Leith, he's back at his mum's for now

Jack - made redundant Fri, whole team gone, 3 months pay. v flat about it, said he'd seen it coming since the restructure in Aug. his gf Hannah's being great. thinking of going freelance or maybe back to uni early next yr. check in sometime next week, prob take him for a pint
Hamza: lives Walthamstow w/ wife + 2 boys. works @ TfL, signalling. older one is 9
Tomás + his brother Rafael - Lisbon 14 May for their gran's 90th. ask T how it went after

Ali's mum - hip op 3rd of June @ Northwick Park. Ali v anxious, she's 78 + had a bad reaction last time. he's taking the wk off to look after her, his brother Hamza covering the wkend after. Ali's wife Efua doing meals. message Ali on the 3rd to see how it went
Natasha Kim (Tash) - new flat in Hackney, moved in early March. housewarming tbc
Luca's wedding OFF. him + Francesca called it a day last wk. don't mention it @ 5 a side
Bethany - nurse @ the Royal, nights mostly. partner Andre is a chef. no kids, 1 cat (Biscuit)
Efua - granddad's funeral 22/10 in Kumasi, flying out Thurs. she's back early Nov. message her before she goes
pick up suit from dry cleaners b4 Sat. also bins Tues

Michael - laid off @ the bank after 12 yrs, found out Tues, out by end of the month. told me at Gemma's. says he's fine but def not, kept changing the subject. wife Natasha back at work so money ok for now but mortgage worries. his boss didn't even tell him in person. remind me to ring him over the wkend + send him that recruiter's number

Anan & Lior - expecting!! due over the summer, roughly mid July. found out at the 12 wk scan last Mon. Lior's sister Carmen already planning the baby shower sometime in June, wants me to help w/ food. Anan's mum over the moon, 1st grandchild. Lior has bad morning sickness tho
Zoe works for the council, planning dept. lives in Didsbury w/ her girlfriend Laila. both vegan
Rory - interview @ Deloitte 11 Nov. bricking it. text him good luck the night b4
Aarav's grandma died last wk. he's gone to Leicester to be w/ his mum. funeral sometime next week, no date yet. need to send flowers to the house
Mariam - from Bradford orig, now Bristol. 2 sisters, younger one Anjali at uni in Leeds
Anders - his dog Pepper put down on Mon. 14 yrs old. gutted. maybe drop round w/ a beer
Sofia + Lukas got married 30 Aug, honeymoon Bali till mid Sept. ask about the trip when they're back

Finn - dumped by Matilda (Tilly) after 3 yrs, out of the blue on his bday. staying at his brother Tunde's in Peckham for a bit till he finds somewhere. Tunde says he's barely sleeping. their mum's coming down from Leeds 10th-12th Nov. Finn wants to keep busy so offered him 5 a side Weds
Gemma - Brighton, works from home, UX at a startup. mum lives w/ her
cancel gym membership end of the month!!
Hannah Murphy update - funeral was 28th, small do. she's back @ work Mon. ask how she's holding up
Carmen - redundancy consultation 5th Dec. 1 of 4 roles going. she thinks it's her. check in after
Tunde: Peckham, shares w/ 2 others. teaches PE @ secondary in Lewisham. supports Arsenal
Rafael - dad not well, scan 19/11 @ Kings. R + his sister taking turns staying w/ him. ring Raf that eve
Michael's 40th 7 Feb - his wife Natasha said he wants a decent coffee grinder. chip in w/ the others
Jack's nan's funeral today. couldn't go. msg him tonight
Lukas and his partner moving to Munich over the summer, his job transferring him. leaving drinks sometime in July
Anjali - finals 12 May. dad really stressed abt it, she's fine apparently

Laila's mum passed away in Jan, cancer, quite quick in the end. L still struggling, bad days esp wkends when she used to ring her. Zoe says she's seeing a counsellor now + it's helping a bit. her dad's on his own in Cardiff, she goes down every other wknd. don't forget to invite L for dinner sometime next week, keep it low key
me: dentist 2/12 9am. car MOT end of Nov
Andre - left the restaurant. starting @ a hotel kitchen in Bath 1st of March. ask how 1st wk goes
Efua's brother Sam - works @ Heathrow, ground crew. lives Hounslow. married, 1 daughter
Ali and his wife - 10th anniv 8 Jan. he's planning a surprise trip to Rome, I'm minding their kids that wknd
Francesca (Fran) - moved back to her parents' in Kent after the breakup. job hunting
Hamza's son Yusuf - starts reception Sept. H nervous more than the kid lol
Bethany & Andre engaged!! asked her in Edinburgh last wkend. send congrats + get a card
Anders: Swedish, came over 2015. lives Bristol, engineer @ Airbus. has a daughter, Sofia, 6
Sam - ex Hannah's brother. lives Dundee. on the boats
Rory's sister - having her 2nd early March. Rory's going up to Glasgow for a wk after
Natasha - redundancy confirmed. last day 31/01. has a payout so not panicking yet, wants to retrain. ask her about the course thing she mentioned
Mariam's grandad passed on the 4th. funeral was yesterday, she went w/ her sisters. she's ok-ish. message her tmrw
Aarav - in Manchester now, Ancoats. works for the BBC in Salford, sound engineer. gf is Matilda

Tomás - his partner Michael left him after 6 yrs. came out of nowhere apparently, M moving to Leeds w/ someone from work. they're selling the house in Hove, viewings start early Jan. T staying w/ me for a few nights from Fri, I'm doing the spare room. their dog Olive going w/ T. he's not eating much. should take him out for food Sat
Lior's parents - 40th anniv party 16th of Dec. Lior asked if I can help w/ the playlist
stag do for Luca called off obvs. got refund from the venue. sort the Airbnb refund too
Zoe - dad's retiring end of the month after 35 yrs @ the post office. family meal Sat. she's making a slideshow
Gemma Lewis - nervous abt her driving test 27/11, 3rd attempt. remind me to wish her luck the day before

Finn's grandma - in hospital since Tues after a fall, broke her wrist + bit confused. he's visiting every eve after work, his mum doing days. they're hoping she's home by the end of the week but might need carers. ask how she is when I see him Thurs
Hannah's mum Bethany - lives Cork, widowed now. Hannah going over for a week over the summer to sort the house
Lukas: 2 kids (Ben 8, Mia 5). wife Sofia is a GP. they're in Clapham
Jack update - got a few interviews lined up, 1st is 3 Dec. sounded way better than last month. ask how it went
Carmen + Lior - Carmen is the older sister, lives in Valencia w/ husband. Lior visits every Easter

Rafael's dad died early hours Sat, after the scan stuff in Nov. funeral 2nd of Dec, crem then the Crown after. R says no flowers, donations to the hospice instead. his sister Sofia flying back from Toronto on the 28th. R doing the eulogy and dreading it. need to donate + ask Raf if he wants me to read it through w/ him before
Anan - flat in Croydon, works @ Tesco HQ, finance. into bouldering, does it 3x a wk w/ his housemate Rory
sort Xmas cards sometime next week. post office closes early Sat
Francesca's dad - prostate cancer, surgery 9 Jan. she's in bits, said her mum's being v strong. call her the wk after
Anjali Gupta - Leeds, 3rd yr med. lives w/ Mariam's cousin. veggie
Sofia (Anders' girl) - dance recital 14/12, 1st one. A wants me there. Laila from work also going, maybe car share
